rules.name: Exact Document Duplicate Detection
rules.description: Calculates SHA-256 fingerprint across all uploaded application documents to detect identical files submitted under differing document types or across other institutional applications.

rules.name: Perceptual Image Hash Match
rules.description: Uses dHash / pHash algorithms to detect rotated, re-compressed, or cropped copies of the same physical campus infrastructure submitted across multiple claims.

rules.name: PDF Metadata Creation Date Inconsistency
rules.description: Detects if document internal creation timestamp postdates the declared notary execution date or if software editing tools (e.g. Photoshop, PDF edit injectors) are detected in producer metadata.

rules.name: Identifier / Registration Conflict
rules.description: Flags discrepancies between registration numbers on certificates vs numbers registered in AICTE master records.

rules.name: Chronological Sequence Violation
rules.description: Verifies that document issue dates, inspection dates, and notary attestations follow strict valid chronological sequence.

rules.name: Error Level Analysis & Compression Edge Anomaly
rules.description: Checks for local variance in JPEG compression artifacts around critical text blocks (e.g., area measurements, registration seals, dates).
